headings.strategy: Technical, uppercase, tracking-widest for labels. Use tracking-tighter for large numeric displays. Banned: Inter, Roboto.

body.strategy: Clean, highly readable geometry. High contrast against dark background.

surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.strategy: Retro-Futurism / Terminal Look. Deep black backgrounds. Borders are 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Scanlines overlay.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.scanlines: CSS repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 3px).
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle red or green drop-shadow on active recording elements.
surfaces_and_visual_enhancers.panels: Flat backgrounds, sharp edges or max 4px radius. High density bento-grid.

buttons.record: Sharp edges, solid #FF1A1A background, pulsing box-shadow when active.
buttons.hotkeys: Border-collapse style grid, 1px border. Hover state slightly lifts with a subtle inner glow.

sliders.style: Thin 2px track, sharp rectangular thumb, glowing track fill.

panels.style: Cardless or 1px border with #0A0A0A background. No shadows. Technical broadcast feel.

teleprompter.style: Monospace text, #F8F8FF text on #000000/80 background (backdrop-blur-md), yellow highlights for directing notes.

components.shadcn_customization: Override default soft radii to rounded-none or rounded-sm. Remove soft shadows, replace with 1px borders.

layout_and_grids.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid. The dashboard wraps a central large 9:16 viewport.
layout_and_grids.structure: Grid columns: 12. Viewport takes 4 columns (centered conceptually or left). Left sidebar: 3 columns (Voice Engine & Scenes). Right sidebar: 5 columns (Teleprompter, Takes, Status dots).
layout_and_grids.spacing: Dense padding (p-4 to p-6) inside panels. Gap-4 between panels.

motion_and_interactions.strategy: Snappy, purposeful. Ticker-like strips for alerts.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Text color shifts to pure white, border opacity increases.
motion_and_interactions.recording_active: Pulse animation on REC button. Red border glow on the 3D viewport canvas.
motion_and_interactions.glitch_burst: CSS keyframe animation for temporary UI glitch effect (skew, rgb split) triggered by hotkey.

accessibility.test_ids: All buttons, sliders, panels MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='record-btn', data-testid='scene-switch-1').

3d_and_media.strategy: 3D Avatar driven by MediaPipe, placed over 2D/3D space backgrounds.
3d_and_media.lighting: Cinematic 3D lighting. Directional rim light (red/blue) to match space backgrounds.
3d_and_media.webcam_pip: Small floating video element, absolute positioned, grayscale filter applied.

worlds.name: Derelict Station
worlds.description: Dark futuristic spaceship interior with glowing beam

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies for styling and 3D: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei @mediapipe/tasks-vision`

Set up a layout with `grid-cols-1` on mobile, `md:grid-cols-12` on desktop. The center piece must be a 9:16 aspect ratio container taking up `col-span-4` (or similar depending on screen) for the video feed.
Implement the CRT scanline overlay using a full-screen or container-relative `pointer-events-none` div with a repeating-linear-gradient and subtle opacity.
Use Phosphor Icons for technical, broadcast-style icons.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on panels. Always use a solid dark background like #0A0A0A or a highly blurred dark translucent layer #000000/80.
Implement the teleprompter to overlay the 3D viewport or sit alongside it, using absolute positioning if overlaying, with `backdrop-blur-md bg-black/60` so the 3D world is still visible underneath.
No generic centering of layout. Left align text and numeric data.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: use 1px borders, dense data displays, and raw broadcast-style typography.
Dark colors look good without gradients. DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds, except for the scanline texture.
Create depth through z-index and border-collapse styles.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Do NOT use universal transition 'all'. Specify properties (e.g. `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`).
DO NOT center align the app container.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
